repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Closed on a reading · 2026-11-26T13:31Z · the premise does not hold on `main`. Read by the `s2-ux-L` area thread on app-crm at main 021524cd (local console, customer Globex, the 商机 related tab):
- The record page's related list no longer has the text filter box or the 全部 / 我的 / 逾期 chips this card was measured on. The related-tab rework of #35892 replaced them with a 排序 / 筛选 condition row: conditions are picked per field and sent as a server `$filter`, options are picked by label, and an empty result reads 没有符合筛选条件的记录.
- The box the card saw is the released `@object-ui/console@18.6.0` (`detail.relatedFilter` 「筛选<title>…」 plus the `relatedChipAll` chips). On `main` those two keys are translation-only, and no code reads them.
- What is left is latent: `RelatedList`'s `filterable` prop (exported by `@object-ui/plugin-detail`) still matches stored values, but no host in the repo passes `filterable=true`, so no user reaches it. A dormant path is not a card (filing gate); the thread's local fix stays unpushed as a PR.
Fixed on `main` by #35892; it ships in the next release. `pm:dispatched` removed.
